item.title: NSU literary mag ‘Nana’s Icebox’ is live
item.description: “Nana’s Icebox,” a single-issue literary magazine created by students in a senior-level class at Northwestern State University, is available to readers online at https://www.argusatnsula.com/nana-s-ice-box. Students in Dr. Rebecca Macijeski’s English 4380 Special Projects class created “Nana’s Icebox,” which features original writing and visual art by young creatives from across Louisiana. item.title: St. Mary’s Catholic School: Cafeteria Technician Position
item.description: St. Mary’s Catholic School is now accepting applications for a Cafeteria Technician. This position involves assisting with daily food preparation, serving students, and maintaining a clean, safe cafeteria environment. Applicants must be able to pass a background check. For more details or to apply, please contact Mrs. Joanne Roque at 318-352-3125.

item.title: Demons open Southland play tonight against 2x reigning champs McNeese
item.description: LAKE CHARLES – The Southland Conference season opens tonight for the Northwestern State men’s basketball team as it faces one of the toughest possible introductions, traveling to take on reigning two-time league champion McNeese. Tipoff is set for 6:30 p.m. and the game will stream live on ESPN+. item.title: NATCHEZ: Mayor calls emergency Town Hall meeting regarding Sewer Lift Pump – TONIGHT
item.description: Mayor Patsy Ward Hoover has called an emergency council meeting for tonight at 6 pm to be held at the town hall, located at 219 Main St. in Natchez. The public is invited to attend the meeting.
